effects: Deploys a new Safe proxy with CREATE2 that points at _singleton, at an address derived from keccak(initializer) and saltNonce.
Calls the new proxy with initializer (Safe setup: owners, threshold, optional delegatecall to/data, fallback handler, payment). The call comes from the factory, not from the signer.
Nothing leaves the signer's wallet beyond gas. The function is not payable, and any setup payment is paid by the new Safe, not by the signer.
formats.shown: "Create Safe" with the singleton address and the decoded Safe setup (owners, threshold, fallback handler, payment, receiver, module data). The salt nonce is hidden.

findings.title: createProxyWithNonce: the address of the new Safe is not shown, because it is computed and not in the calldata.
findings.evidence: GnosisSafeProxyFactory.sol deployProxyWithNonce: salt = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(keccak256(initializer), saltNonce)); create2(...). No field can show the resulting address.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730 today. The wallet could compute and show the predicted address.

findings.title: createProxyWithNonce: the singleton shows as a raw address in the test screen, so the signer cannot tell it is the official Safe code.
findings.evidence: case 1 screen: 'Safe singleton' = 0x3E5c63644E683549055b9Be8653de26E0B4CD36E. Descriptor uses addressName with types [contract], so name resolution is up to the wallet.
findings.fix: Wallets should resolve known Safe singletons. The descriptor is already set up correctly for that.

cases.notes: Not mined. From the code: no asset moves for the signer. The screen shows the owners and threshold of the new Safe, and the setup payment is 0.

formats.key: createProxyWithCallback(address _singleton, bytes initializer, uint256 saltNonce, address callback)
effects: Deploys a new Safe proxy with CREATE2 that points at _singleton. The salt is derived from initializer, saltNonce and callback.
Calls the new proxy with initializer (Safe setup: owners, threshold, optional delegatecall, fallback handler, payment) from the factory.
If callback is not zero, the factory calls callback.proxyCreated(proxy, _singleton, initializer, saltNonce). This external code runs as the factory, not as the signer.
Nothing leaves the signer's wallet beyond gas. The function is not payable.
formats.shown: "Create Safe" with the singleton address and the decoded Safe setup. The salt nonce and the callback contract are hidden.

findings.title: createProxyWithCallback: the callback contract is visible:never, so the external call it receives is not shown.
findings.evidence: GnosisSafeProxyFactory.sol createProxyWithCallback: if (address(callback) != address(0)) callback.proxyCreated(proxy, _singleton, initializer, saltNonce); descriptor: {"label":"Callback","path":"callback","visible":"never"}. The call runs as the factory and moves none of the signer's assets (not_critical #5).
findings.fix: Show the callback as an addressName field with visible: ifNotIn [0x000...0], so the signer can see which contract gets notified.

findings.title: createProxyWithCallback: the address of the new Safe is not shown, because it is computed and not in the calldata.
findings.evidence: createProxyWithCallback: saltNonceWithCallback = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(saltNonce, callback))); then CREATE2 in deployProxyWithNonce.

cases.notes: Mined tx 0x1a78...c62b had no token, ETH or approval effects. The callback was 0x8a95ce...7c05 and is hidden. The reader understood correctly that the signer only creates a 2-of-3 Safe and pays nothing but gas.
